title: ViT Spectrogram
subtitle: Deployment

overview.title: Artifact in input units
overview.description: Centre selection, optional DC removal and rescaling

nodes.title: Deployment input normalisation
description: Demean across configured axes; optionally divide by input standard deviation.
Packing and context axis come from the run configuration.

nodes.title: Temporal context
description: Flatten channel-wise context to one waveform.

nodes.title: Complex STFT
description: Retain complex coefficients and cropped frequency/time geometry.

nodes.title: Magnitude patches
description: log(1 + magnitude), non-overlapping patches and token projection.

nodes.title: Masked-token encoder
description: Replace masked tokens, add positions and apply pre-norm Transformer blocks.

nodes.title: Complex mask head
description: Predict real and imaginary masks; bounded tanh on each component.

nodes.title: Spectral reconstruction
description: Multiply the complex mask by the input complex STFT.

nodes.title: Inverse STFT and centre
description: Restore spectral padding; inverse STFT; select the centre waveform.

nodes.title: Deployment artifact output
description: Convert the configured core output to a centre artifact.
Optionally remove prediction DC; restore the input scale.

edges.label: Deployment input normalisation to Temporal context
Masked-token encoder to Complex mask head
Complex mask head to Spectral reconstruction
Spectral reconstruction to Inverse STFT and centre
Inverse STFT and centre to Deployment artifact output

notes: Magnitude and complex-mask variants have different output heads.
Deployment changes normalisation and objective; architecture parameters remain configuration-dependent.
Dimensions and repeated-block counts are configurable; consult the linked implementation and run configuration.
